REPAIR ROUND (2026-09-29): the vls_bank naval_weapon_system.mounts entry has been REMOVED entirely. Runtime fact verified by the coordinator in src/models/weapons/naval_weapon_mounts.h and src/core/engine/simulation_kernel_weapon_release_service.cpp's select_ready_vls_mount: it fires the first vls_sam mount with available rounds and no cooldown, and target_domain is stored but NEVER READ at runtime. This means the prior 'target_domain: land, structural placeholder' annotation had zero effect -- the engine would have treated these 24 cells as a functioning submarine-mounted SAM system, which is unrealistic (a submarine has no SAM). The 24-cell VLS is now documented ONLY in _real_world.weapon_inventory as content_only_no_mechanism with launcher '24-cell VLS'; this hull now has zero naval_weapon_system.mounts[] entries, consistent with Type 093A's precedent for torpedo-only submarines.
SSN escort presence in a Fujian CSG, and specifically the choice of 093B (VLS-armed) over 093A, is an analyst assumption never PRC-confirmed, per the OOB's own Arbitrated Corrections.
The 24-cell VLS cell count itself (ONI A-tier baseline) is unchanged by this repair; only its runtime representation moved from a functional mount to a content-only inventory entry.
